name: Darkmoon Faire
when: Monthly, one week from Monday 04:00 realm time. Nov 9-15 2026 (Elwynn), Dec 7-13 2026 (Mulgore), Jan 4-10 2027 (Elwynn)
where: Alternates between Goldshire, Elwynn Forest and the foot of Thunder Bluff, Mulgore
what: Travelling carnival with games, ticket turn-ins and Sayge's fortunes. Sayge gives one of eight 2-hour buffs (+10% damage, armor, a stat, or +25 resistances). In Forever, world buffs do nothing inside raids but still work in the open world, dungeons and battlegrounds.

name: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza
when: Weekly on Sundays, starting 14:00 realm time
what: Fishing tournament: the first angler to bring 40 Speckled Tastyfish to Riggle Bassbait wins; anyone can also turn in rare fish for prizes.
rewards: Grand prize for the winner (Arcanite Fishing Pole or Glinting Steel Dagger in vanilla)

name: Call to Arms (featured battleground)
when: Week-long, rotating every 3 weeks: Arathi Basin Nov 3-10, Warsong Gulch Nov 10-17, Darkspear Islands Nov 17-24 2026
where: Battlemasters in capitals and The Barrens
what: One battleground is highlighted each week with boosted honor and Rank Points.

name: Raid launch
where: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20), Onyxia's Lair (40)
what: All three launch raids unlock on the same day for level 60s, with weekly lockouts.

name: Invite-A-Friend launch week
what: Players with an Invite-A-Friend code could play Forever without a subscription during launch week.

name: Feast of Winter Veil
where: Ironforge and Orgrimmar (Greatfather Winter), plus wider Azeroth
what: Winter holiday with gift-giving, snowball fights and holiday quests; presents appear under the city trees on Christmas Day.

name: Lunar Festival
where: Moonglade and Elder locations across Azeroth
what: Seek out the Elders around the world for coins, celebrating in Moonglade with feasts and fireworks.

name: Love is in the Air
what: Exchange gifts and tokens of affection among citizens.

name: Noblegarden
what: Hunt for brightly coloured eggs hidden in each race's starting area.

name: Children's Week
what: Adopt an orphan and take them on a sightseeing tour.
rewards: Companion pets from the orphan quests

name: Midsummer Fire Festival
what: Summer festival with bonfires to honour and to desecrate in each capital and zone.

name: Hallow's End
what: Trick-or-treat at innkeepers and take part in Halloween festivities.

name: Gurubashi Arena chest
what: A free-for-all PvP scramble for a chest that drops into the arena.
